category_title: Students with LD who use prior knowledge or memory to predict future story events
scenario_title: Anticipating future events with prior knowledge of the book
minimal_context: The student is participating in a small reading group and anticipating future events in the book 'The Mouse and the Motorcycle'.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are about to read the next part of 'The Mouse and the Motorcycle'. What do you want to find out in the text we are about to read?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Does Ralph have a sister that is going to lose—I mean a brother that is going to try and ride the motorcycle and then ()

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: So usually when we predict, we predict off of what we read so far. Where is that prediction coming from?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Well, in third grade my teacher read the book to the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I see. But what can we predict based on what we have read together?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know... it was just a silly prediction.
